# Golden Bay Technologies (GBTech)

Systems architecture, custom business software, legacy database modernization, and resilient IT infrastructure management based in Nelson/Tasman and serving clients across New Zealand. Founded and operated by Warwick Marshall from Tākaka since 2014.

Core proposition: Custom operational software when you need systems built; structural IT diagnostics and legacy modernization when you need mission-critical stability.

Site: https://gbtech.co.nz/
Contact: Warwick Marshall · warwick.marshall@gmail.com · +64 27 814 2222

## Primary capabilities

1. **Custom Business Software & Operational Apps** — Multi-user web portals, offline-ready field management systems, team coordination, and flexible backends across Microsoft Dataverse, relational SQL, and modern cloud databases (such as Firestore).
2. **Enterprise Data Security in the AI Age (PowerApps & Dataverse)** — Specifically advocating and building inside Microsoft Dataverse and PowerApps for businesses concerned about data governance, RBAC, and privacy in this AI age — moving off vulnerable local SQL into Microsoft-managed compliance.
3. **Legacy Modernization & Database Architecture** — Migrating aging desktop software (VB.NET, Windows Forms, Access) and on-premises SQL Server instances to secure, modern web architectures with verified data integrity and disaster recovery pipelines.
4. **Owned Web Presence & Booking Engines** — High-performance, crawler-ready websites and Google Calendar sync booking portals that businesses fully own, eliminating monthly SaaS rent (Wix, Squarespace, Calendly).
5. **IT Infrastructure Resilience & Cloud Workplace** — Full-stack fault isolation, disaster recovery clones, network stability, cybersecurity compliance, and Microsoft 365 cloud administration.
